## Description
A clear and concise summary of changes, problem addressed, and architectural reasoning.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing behavior to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Compatibility matrix / receipt evidence update

## Verification Discipline
- [ ] All tests pass on Python 3.9 and Python 3.13 (`pytest -q`).
- [ ] Static type checker passes without warnings (`mypy apkrevive`).
- [ ] Linter passes cleanly (`ruff check .`).
- [ ] If this PR modifies device compatibility claims, a non-simulated receipt generated by `scripts/make_receipt.py` is included in `receipts/`.
- [ ] No personal serial numbers, host paths, or private keystores are committed.
